rollups.text: Farmers-market and food-business plans: By 2023-05-22, the user was selling homemade jams and preserves at a weekly downtown farmers market and said sales were going well. For an Easter Market described as April 16 (year unspecified; the date had passed by the 2023-05-22 conversation), the user planned 100–150 jars of an 8 oz limited-edition Easter jam with bunny-shaped labels, a price slightly above regular flavors, at least 50% profit margin, and about $3.50 cost of goods per jar; the stall fee was $50. Planned promotions were a BOGO offer and free gift wrapping above an undecided purchase amount, advertised on social media and stall signage. The user was also considering a loyalty program or email sign-up and vendor cross-promotion. On 2023-05-22, the user said they wanted to start a Greek-Mexican fusion food truck; a sample menu was drafted, but no launch was reported.

Running and exercise: By 2023-02-15, the user was working toward running a 5K by the end of March 2023; the proposed plan included Thursday intervals and Saturday hill repeats alongside yoga, weightlifting, and recovery, with the goal period lasting roughly six weeks. By 2023-05-22, the user said evening exercise after dinner was feasible 4–5 times weekly for at least 45 minutes, named yoga, jogging, and weightlifting as preferred activities, used Nike Running to track progress, and aimed for 10,000 daily steps. The user was concerned weekend social plans might crowd out longer runs and welcomed scheduling suggestions. The user had not chosen a particular recommended running tracker or app.

Travel plans and experiences: The user reported a solo two-week backpacking trip through Italy, Switzerland, and Germany in summer 2022, including Munich. In 2023-05, the user discussed a planned solo Arizona trip beyond the Grand Canyon, which they had visited with family several years earlier; they were interested in Sedona and Monument Valley, considered 4–5 days in Sedona and 2–3 in Monument Valley, and decided on a Hoover Dam detour on the return to Phoenix. No bookings or completed Arizona trip were reported. The user also discussed a late-September 2023 return trip to Germany, expecting 3–4 nights in Munich and considering Oktoberfest, Nymphenburg Palace, Dachau Memorial Site, and the Deutsches Museum; no booking or attendance was reported. On 2023-05-22, the user was planning another trip with destination unspecified and was inspired by an unnamed travel blogger on Instagram.

Living-room and home-decor items: Around 2023-05-01, the user put up a new bookshelf in the living room, which made a major difference. It holds mostly novels, some self-help books, and decorative items collected on travels or received from friends and family, including a new vase from the user's aunt. During 2023-05, the user acquired a garage-sale coffee table and enjoyed using it daily for morning coffee and relaxation; the user was experimenting with room layouts and considering a vase similar to the aunt's vase for the table. The user was looking for an area rug for the dining room and affordable stylish couch pillows to coordinate with the vase.

Plants and plant care: By 2023-05-22, the user had a spider plant and basil plant. The spider plant had been too dry, so the user increased watering and planned to monitor soil moisture. The user had treated whiteflies on the basil with neem oil and isolated it, which seemed to work. The user was planning to bring home a Prayer Plant (Maranta leuconeura), but had not yet done so; plans included checking soil moisture before watering, regular misting, and possibly getting a humidifier. The user sets phone reminders to water plants on Wednesday mornings.

Fitness and wellness activities and tools: The user has done yoga, jogging/running, and weightlifting and uses Nike Running to track progress; the user aimed to reach 10,000 steps a day. The user bought a Fossil smartwatch in April 2023 and was enjoying it. By 2023-05-22, the user was considering an additional dedicated fitness tracker, leaning toward Fitbit and asking about the Inspire HR; the user had also asked about runner-focused trackers and connected GPS, but had not stated a purchase.

Skincare concerns and plans: On 2023-05-22, the user described combination skin, acne and hyperpigmentation concerns, a preference for natural and organic skincare, and liking @beautybylily's natural-product routine. The user had recently noticed severe dark circles and planned to try more sleep and hydration, journal skincare use and possible triggers, and engage thoughtfully with skincare content without comparing themselves to others. The user was interested in trying The Ordinary Retinol 0.5% Night Cream for anti-aging, but the records do not confirm purchase or use; the user asked how to use retinol and what results to expect, and about complementary products.

Books, audiobooks, and reading interests: By 2023-05-22, the user said they enjoyed fiction audiobooks during a daily commute of about an hour each way and used Audible, whose bookmark and note features they described. The user was already reading Gone Girl by Gillian Flynn on Kindle and said The Nightingale by Kristin Hannah sounded interesting. The user said audiobooks helped them retain more than e-books and had started taking notes, especially on nonfiction insights; they planned to explore other note-taking apps. The user's living-room bookshelf, acquired around 2023-05-01, held mostly novels and some self-help books.

Ceramics and sculpting: By 2023-05-22, the user had taken sculpting classes at a local studio for about three months and said they had learned a lot; the instructor emphasized wedging and kneading clay. The user was interested in black stoneware and had trouble finding the right consistency for a technique seen on YouTube. Their next project was a ceramic cat figurine with fine whisker details. They were considering a home studio to experiment more and outlined a setup with a sturdy table and pottery wheel, storage for clay/glazes/tools, kiln and glaze/slip areas, efficient workflow, good lighting, and ventilation. No studio purchase or construction was reported.

Senior Marketing Manager role and team organization: By 2023-05-22, the user had been working as Senior Marketing Manager at Smith & Co. for about six weeks and was still learning team dynamics and individual strengths. The user wanted to align personal priorities with team goals, communicate goals clearly, and delegate according to strengths. Planned steps included trying Trello and Todoist, holding one-on-one meetings, creating a skills-assessment matrix, making a task-assignment matrix, and clearly communicating expectations, timelines, and resources. No outcomes of these plans were reported.

Technology owned, considered, or purchased: On 2023-05-22, the user said they had a new Dell XPS 13 with 16 GB RAM and a 512 GB SSD, intended for browsing, email, documents, video editing, and photo editing, and had bought a three-year warranty for $200. The user had sold an old Lenovo ThinkPad to a friend for $400 and was considering a Samsung T5 portable SSD for transferring documents, photos, and videos and backing up between laptop and desktop. The user also said they had bought an Anker power bank for about $40 and a Samsung Galaxy S22 Ultra from Best Buy as an upgrade from an iPhone 11 Pro. A 2023-05-22 conversation separately described the user as nearly ready to purchase an XPS 13 and planning to go ahead; the records do not establish the precise purchase date.

Gifts given, considered, and gift recipients: Around 2023-05-01, the user bought the user's sister a silver necklace for about $50; the sister loved it. On the weekend of 2023-05-20–21, the user found a Tiffany & Co. silver necklace the sister had wanted for months, and the sister loved it; the records may refer to the same gift, so do not count them as two separate necklaces. By 2023-05-22, the user was considering a yoga mat, strap, and studio gift card for a best friend interested in yoga and fitness; this was a proposed gift, not a confirmed purchase. The user was also considering a customized mug or tea infuser for the user's tea-loving mother and planned to look at local gift shops on 2023-05-27–28, but had not chosen or bought one. The user planned an engraved silver pendant for a recently promoted female colleague, budget $40–$60, with “Believe in Yourself” and the colleague's name; no order was confirmed.

The user described one completed 10-day social-media break, during which Instagram and Facebook apps were deleted from the phone. After reinstalling them, the user aimed to limit use to 30 minutes in the morning and 30 minutes in the evening. The user also planned to batch Instagram travel content by preparing photos and captions in advance.

International student community involvement: The user attended the university's international-student orientation about two weeks after arriving and enjoyed meeting people from around the world. By 2023-05-22, the user wanted to become more involved, was interested in the International Student Organization's cultural nights and volunteering, and was considering hosting a Brazilian-themed cultural event. Planned next steps were to contact the organization about the idea and campus resources and ask language-exchange friends and a Brazilian roommate for input and help while respecting their time and expertise. No event or contact was reported as completed.
